description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class 'PickerActivity' that provides a user interface for selecting items from a list with search capability. It includes methods for asynchronously loading list data, filtering based on user input, and handling selection results.

classes.name: PickerActivity
classes.description: An abstract activity class providing a searchable list interface for item selection, with asynchronous data loading.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the list of items to display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity UI, initializes views, and starts loading the data.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing data loading task before activity destruction.

methods.name: getSelectedString
methods.description: Extracts the selected item string from an Intent.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Retrieves the selected item string from the adapter at a given position.

methods.name: onListItemClicked
methods.description: Handles item click events, returning the selected item via Intent.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Filters all items based on search input and updates the list display.
